defects.claim: Content press released across the border within the drag threshold fires onContentClick with a frame point; release zone unchecked
defects.scenario: pointer down just inside the content, release on the adjacent border within the drag threshold; onContentClick is called with a frame point
defects.cause: release branch skips the release-zone check

defects.claim: Close hit zone spans the full titlebar height in the close columns, so presses below the drawn close box close the window
defects.scenario: with defaults, a press and release at y=22 from the top closes the window, though the box ends at y=19
defects.cause: hit test ignores the close box's vertical extent

defects.claim: setRows clamps scroll without revealing the preserved active row, so a reorder can leave the focused row offscreen yet activatable
defects.scenario: a focused fixed-height list whose active row moves from the first visible slot to the bottom; the focus ring disappears and Enter activates the hidden row
